_comment: Non-secret pipeline configuration. The API key is never stored here — it comes from the YOUTUBE_API_KEY repository secret at run time.

wikipedia._comment_eulimit: 'max' lets the API clamp to whatever the caller's rights allow (500 for bot/sysop rights, 50 for anonymous) rather than erroring. See README for the resulting assumption.

expansion._comment: channelSectionsPerRun bounds channelSections.list calls (1 unit each) per run; expansion continues across runs via the 'sectionsChecked' flag persisted in graph.json.

quota._comment: Kept below the real 10,000/day ceiling so normal daily jitter (other tools using the same key, retries) doesn't tip a run into an actual quotaExceeded error.

items._comment_rss: Best-effort, zero-quota discovery of a channel's most recent video IDs via its videos.xml uploads feed, fetched only from the job (never the reader). Falls back to playlistItems.list (1 unit) on any failure — cloud IPs get rate-limited harder than residential ones, so this must never block a run.

schedule._comment: Informational mirror of the schedule actually configured in .github/workflows/discovery-ingest.yml. GitHub Actions requires the cron expression to live in the workflow YAML itself — there is no mechanism for a workflow to read its own trigger schedule from a JSON file at trigger-evaluation time. This field exists so the schedule is still visible and diffable as configuration; if you change one, change the other. See README 'Conflicts with the brief' section.
